title: Discovery
description: Businesses found in lawful public sources. Nothing becomes public until a moderator approves. Every run is logged.

sources.emptyBody: A source is a dataset under contract, a list of businesses' public pages or the ONRC adapter. It starts paused.
sources.queued: The run has been queued. It appears in the log when it starts.
sources.alreadyQueued: A run of this source is already queued.

sourceForm.name: Name
sourceForm.kindLocked: A source's kind cannot change after it is created.
sourceForm.termsHint: The contract number, licence or terms that allow using the source.
sourceForm.rateHint: How many HTTP requests the source may make in an hour, robots.txt included.
sourceForm.urlHint: Optional if you paste the content below.
sourceForm.inlineHint: Columns: name, category, county, locality, contact, email, phone, identifier, website, url. At most 2 MB.
sourceForm.urlsHint: One https address per line, at most 200. Only the page's schema.org data and meta tags are read.
sourceForm.defaultCategoryHint: For rows that name no category.
sourceForm.targetCategoriesHint: Category ids separated by commas. Empty = all.
sourceForm.targetCountiesHint: County codes separated by commas, for example CJ, B, IF. Empty = all.
sourceForm.onrcNote: The ONRC source uses an adapter installed by the operator. Without one, the run is logged and produces nothing.
sourceForm.created: Source added. It is paused until you switch it on.

drafts.emptyBody: Drafts appear after a source has run.
drafts.fixNamed: Correct the category and locality for {name}
drafts.batchBody: One decision and one reason for the whole batch. Approval publishes a minimal listing, labelled "Added by EventDesk — not claimed yet".
drafts.reasonHint: Kept in the log and in the moderation record.

done.approve: Batch approved: the listings are public.

drafts.needModerator: Approving needs the listing moderator role.
drafts.fixBody: You correct only the guessed classification. The name, the contact and the source stay as collected.
drafts.notInvited: No invitation: the source has no email

runs.emptyBody: The log shows every run: the source, what it saw, the drafts it created and the duplicates it set aside.

objections.emptyBody: Removal requests, objections and corrections sent for unclaimed listings appear here, with the 30-day deadline.
objections.honourNote: For a removal or an objection the listing is withdrawn at once and the business is never discovered again.
objections.noteHint: The evidence of handling, kept 3 years.

claims.emptyBody: When someone claims an unclaimed listing, the request appears here after the proof.
claims.check: The check against the public source
claims.checkHint: What you compared with what: for example the administrator's name in the register with the document sent.
claims.checkHintCode: Optional: the code sent to the published address was confirmed.
claims.submitted: Sent for approval. A second person approves it under "Approvals".
claims.inApproval: Waiting for a second person under "Approvals".

errors.termsRequired: Write the basis that allows using the source.
errors.urlHttps: Use public https addresses, without a user name and password.
errors.datasetRequired: Give the file address or paste the content.
errors.nameTaken: A source with this name already exists.
errors.paused: The source is paused. Switch it on before running it.
errors.reasonRequired: Write the reason, at least 10 characters.
errors.draftIncomplete: "{name}" has no category and locality from the lists yet. Correct it, then approve.
errors.listingClaimed: The listing has been claimed in the meantime; it can no longer be withdrawn from here.

invitation.subject: "{listing}" appears in the EventDesk directory
invitation.who: EventDesk, a Romanian event-planning app, has added a minimal listing for "{listing}" to its directory, from public information ({source}, collected on {date}).
invitation.what: The listing shows only the name, the category, the area and the public contact. It is labelled "Added by EventDesk — not claimed yet" and receives no enquiries through the platform.
invitation.correct: Once claimed, you can correct and complete it. Claiming is free and is verified with a code sent to this address.
invitation.remove: If you want it removed or you object to it, use this link: {url} — the listing is withdrawn at once.
invitation.once: This is the only message you will receive from EventDesk about this listing. We send no advertising.

kindHelp.licensed_dataset: A CSV or JSON file received under contract: paste it here or give its https address.
kindHelp.business_page: A list of businesses' public pages. Only each page's schema.org data and meta tags are read.
kindHelp.onrc_public: The Trade Register's public data, through an adapter installed by the operator.
